errorCodes.meaning: `kudosMakers.roles` names a role the community does not define, or `kudosMakers.groups` names a group that does not exist or that backs a badge. Nothing was stored.

BadgeLimits.description: The community's bounds (VTI-BDG-032, VTI-BDG-040). Each has a default a community that states none applies.

kudosBadgesPerMakerPerMonth.description: Kudos badges one member may make in a calendar month. Default 5.

kudosPerGiverPerDay.description: Kudos one member may give in a day. Default 10.

maxPinned.description: Badges a member may pin beside their name. Default 2.

minTenureDays.description: Days of membership before a member may give kudos or make a kudos badge. Default 7.

offerExpiresAfterDays.description: Days an unanswered offer stands before it expires. Absent: offers do not expire.

sameGiverSameMember.description: How often the same member may give a kudos badge to the same member: at most once a day, once a week, or without bound. Default `day`.

BadgeLimits.title: BadgeLimits

BadgeSettings.description: The community's badge settings (VTI-BDG-004). `enabled` false hides every badge surface and keeps every record; nothing is given or issued while it is false.

automaticBadges.description: Whether dynamic badge groups are computed (VTI-BDG-013). False: a community badge may not be created on a dynamic group, and existing ones are not recomputed.

credentialValidDays.description: Validity of a badge credential its holders may show outside (VTI-BDG-062). Default 730.

membersMayRequest.description: Whether any community badge may be marked `requestable`. False: every badge group is closed.

showKudosTotals.description: Whether a member's kudos total is shown on their card (VTI-BDG-043).

BadgeSettings.title: BadgeSettings
